explanation: W=1.5929 GeV is above the ep -> e'p eta threshold (m_p + m_eta = 1.4861 GeV), and Q2=0.4276 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=-0.527586, phi*=300 deg are all within the tabulated EtaMAID-2023 grid, so the point is physically accessible and the run completed with no NAG/integration errors, NaNs, or unphysical-point flags. Note: the prebuilt exclurad executable hard-codes open(unit=5,file='input.dat') in exclurad.F, so '<' stdin redirection is ignored; the point had to be written directly into eta/input.dat (model=3 maid2000/EtaMAID, rc_mode=0 full O(alpha), bmom=6.53 GeV, ivec=1 recoil proton, vcut=0.166 GeV^2 -- all CLAS12 defaults per README.md) before running ./build/exclurad with no arguments. delta is the unpolarized radiative-correction ratio sigma_observed/sigma_Born (sigar(1)/sibar(1) in the source), and sigma_born is the unpolarized 5-fold-differential Born cross section (sibar(1), internal code units GeV^-2 scaled by barn=0.389379e6, i.e. effectively nb/GeV^4-type units as produced natively by the code). Both values are copied verbatim (10 significant decimal digits) from eta/radtot.dat, column order: e1, W, Q2, cos(theta*), phi*, sigar(1)/sibar(1) [delta], sibar(1) [sigma_born], as, asb, dd.
